design: Original TH10 Lunatic official trial stage 1 with stock lives, four sampled actions and no Continue. One momentum host per matched pair. First half of controller seeds plays held-four-ppo first; second half plays held-four-ppo2 first. Game RNG and concurrent host load uncontrolled. The 9-way movement switch rate counts every change between consecutive decisions, including neutral, within each credit.
